overall: The AG found the Field Partnership Group is not a public body under the OML because it lacks a defined membership empowered to act collectively, so it did not violate the Law.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged that the Bedford Field Partnership Group, an informal group of mostly Town staff on athletic fields, does not follow the Open Meeting Law.
allegations.key_passage: However, the Group does not meet the second prong of this test because it does not have a defined membership that is empowered to act collectively.
